Priya - People Ops: Quick announcement: were launching a 6-month pilot for Adoption & Fertility Leave Top-Up, effective today. Key points: up to 8 weeks of paid top-up (bump to 100% base pay) that sits on top of statutory/state benefits; one-time fertility/adoption reimbursement up to $3,000; eligibility: full-time employees with 6+ months tenure. Policy + claim form: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/adopt-fertility-pilot

Marcus - People Ops: Super short TL;DR for managers: 1) Top-up is approved by People Ops (use the "Parental Top-Up" workflow), 2) Reimbursement requires receipts within 90 days, 3) International variants apply (see policy). This does NOT reduce your regular PTO.

Lina: Amazing news 60a64fQuestion: how does this interact with state disability or paid family leave?

Priya - People Ops: Great Q 4acTop-up is designed to be additive. We pay the difference between statutory benefit and full base salary for up to 8 weeks. If an employee receives no statutory pay, we still provide the full top-up amount (subject to payroll limits). We included a few examples in the doc.

Tobias: Is the $3k reimbursement per family or per employee? Also tax implications?

Marcus - People Ops: It's per eligible employee per pilot event (so if both parents are Redwood employees each can claim). The reimbursement is taxable; payroll will issue on the next paycheck and well provide a tax summary.

Lina: What about managers who need to arrange backfill for 8 weeks? Any hiring guidance?

Priya - People Ops: We recommend short-term contractors or internal backfills. Managers can request a temporary headcount approval via People Ops; we'll fast-track for pilot cases. Please discuss in your weekly 1:1s and flag to your recruiter early.

Tobias: How do employees start a claim?

Priya - People Ops: Claim form in Workday under "Leaves & Benefits" > "Parental Top-Up Pilot". If urgent, email people-ops@redwood.com and copy your manager; we'll start manual processing.

Payroll-Bot: Official policy uploaded: https://redwoodintra.company/policies/adopt-fertility-pilot.pdf. Reimbursement form v1 attached to the doc.

Marcus - People Ops: We're hosting an info drop-in Friday 11:00am PT for Q&A and payroll walkthrough. Invite linked in the policy doc. Managers only session at 11:45 for operational tips.

Lina: Thanks team 44dWill forward to our hiring leads.

Tobias: Appreciate it 970One request: can we add guidance for cross-border adoptions?

Priya - People Ops: Noted 4ddWe have an international addendum section in the doc but will expand for adoptions. Send specific cases to people-ops and we'll prioritize.
